set.live.paused: Live updates are paused, so providers, keys and servers shown here may be out of date.
set.live.error: Live updates were interrupted ({error}). PingDeck is trying again.
set.secret.stored: Stored on this computer. Never shown again.
set.secret.noLimit: The key length limit has not loaded, so keys cannot be saved yet. Reload settings.
set.secret.down: Secret storage is unavailable: {reason}. Keys cannot be read or saved.
set.f.general.language.d: Model replies follow the language you write in, not this setting.
set.f.general.language.syn: locale, chinese, english, 语言, 中文, 英文
set.f.general.restore_session.d: Reopens the request tabs and unsent drafts you had open. Off opens the last module with nothing restored.
set.f.general.restore_session.syn: session, reopen, startup, 恢复标签页, 启动
set.f.general.dock_bounce.d: When a chat run needs your approval, or a run that took over 30 seconds finishes, while another app is in front, the app icon bounces once (on Windows and Linux the taskbar entry flashes). Where the system shows badges, the icon badge always counts approvals waiting.
set.f.general.dock_bounce.syn: dock, taskbar, notification, attention, badge, 通知, 程序坞, 任务栏
set.sec.general.signals.d: How PingDeck gets your attention when its window isn't in front.
set.f.general.notify_when_away.d: Sent when a chat run waits on you, never while PingDeck is in front, at most one per chat every 30 seconds. They name the chat and the kind of step, never commands or paths. The first one asks the system for permission.
set.f.general.notify_when_away.syn: notification, alert, away, banner, 通知, 系统通知, 横幅
set.f.appearance.theme.d: Follow system switches with the system appearance. The system’s Increase contrast applies too.
set.f.appearance.theme.syn: dark mode, light mode, color, 主题, 深色, 浅色
set.f.appearance.palette.d: Pairs low-glare surfaces with high-contrast text and accents across light and dark modes.
set.f.appearance.density.d: Compact tightens rows in tables, logs and lists from 30 to 26 px.
set.f.appearance.density.syn: compact, spacing, rows, 密度, 紧凑
set.f.appearance.ui_font_size.d: Scales labels, tables and chat text together.
set.f.appearance.ui_font_size.syn: text size, zoom, larger text, 字号, 字体大小
set.f.appearance.mono_font_size.d: Request bodies, responses, logs and code blocks. The line height follows.
set.f.appearance.mono_font_size.syn: monospace, editor font, 代码字号, 等宽
set.f.appearance.reduce_motion.d: Follow system uses the system accessibility setting. On plays no transitions, including the highlight after a link jump.
set.f.appearance.reduce_motion.syn: animation, transitions, accessibility, 动画, 减少动态
set.f.shortcuts.overrides.d: Keys you changed. Commands not listed keep their default.
set.f.shortcuts.overrides.syn: keyboard, hotkey, keybinding, 快捷键, 键位
set.shortcuts.restoreAll.title: Restore all shortcuts?
set.shortcuts.restoreAll.body: Every key you changed goes back to its default. You can undo this for a few seconds.
set.shortcuts.changeNone: Change shortcut for {name}, currently not set
set.shortcuts.recordingFor: Recording a shortcut for {name}: press the keys, Esc cancels
set.shortcuts.refused: Use ⌘, ⌃ or ⌥ together with a key
set.shortcuts.fixed.d: Undo, copy and paste are reserved by the operating system.
set.f.network.timeout_ms.d: How long a request may take before it is cancelled.
set.f.network.follow_redirects.d: Follows 3xx answers to the new address.
set.f.network.max_redirects.d: Past this many hops the request fails.
set.f.network.http_version.d: The protocol version new requests ask for. Auto lets the server choose.
set.f.network.retry_count.d: Retries after a network error, never after an HTTP response, 5xx included. POST and PATCH retry only when the connection was never made. The gateway does not use this.
set.f.editor.tab_size.d: Spaces inserted by the Tab key in editors.
set.f.editor.word_wrap.d: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways.
set.f.editor.editor_highlight_limit_byte: Larger request bodies show as plain text so editing stays fast.
syntax, highlight, large, editor highlight limit, 高亮
set.f.data.response_body_cap_bytes.d: Larger responses are cut at this size.
set.f.data.response_body_cap_bytes.syn: body, size, cap, truncate, largest response to keep, 响应大小
set.f.editor.viewer_highlight_limit_byte: Larger responses show as plain text.
syntax, highlight, large, viewer highlight limit, 高亮
set.sec.requests.defaults.d: Requests follow these unless their Network tab sets a value of their own; a change applies at the next send.
set.requests.tlsOff: Certificates are not checked for new requests.
set.requests.tlsOff.link: Self-signed certificates can go in the CA bundle
set.f.data.inline_threshold_bytes.d: Responses up to this size load whole. Larger ones show a preview first and load in full when needed.
set.f.data.inline_threshold_bytes.syn: response, transport, inline, threshold, 内联, 内联阈值
set.f.data.preview_bytes.d: How much of a larger response shows first. At most the full load limit.
set.f.network.proxy_url.d: http, https, socks5 or socks5h. Credentials in the URL show masked after saving.
set.f.network.no_proxy.d: Hosts and suffixes that skip the proxy, for requests and providers.
set.f.network.ca_bundle_path.d: An extra PEM file of trusted certificate authorities for requests, providers and the add-provider scan.
set.sec.network.proxy.d: Outbound connections of requests, providers and web tools go through it.
set.network.mode.d: Requests, providers and the add-provider scan follow this rule. Local addresses, Mock servers and hosts below go direct.
set.network.test.proxyUnreachable: Can't reach the proxy. Is Clash or Surge running?
set.network.test.proxyAuth: The proxy asked for credentials (407). Put them in the proxy URL.
set.network.test.proxyRefused: The proxy refused to open a tunnel to the target.
set.network.test.noResponse: Proxy reached, target didn't respond ({route}, {target} within 10 s)
set.network.provider: A provider can set its own proxy, or none, in its Config tab.
set.network.ca.empty: No certificates found in this file
set.f.mock.first_port.d: The first port tried for a new mock server.
set.f.mock.default_latency_ms.d: Delay added to every answer of a new mock server.
set.f.mock.cors_default.d: New mock servers add CORS headers to their answers.
set.f.mock.log_capacity.d: Requests each mock server keeps in memory, running ones included. When you lower it, the oldest entries go with the next request.
set.sec.mock.defaults.d: A running server keeps its own values.
set.f.data.history_retention: History to keep, per workspace and source
set.f.data.history_retention.d: Requests, agent sends, collection runs and flows each keep this many entries; runs are dropped whole, the newest is always kept. Older entries are deleted when a new one is written.
set.f.data.history_retention.syn: retention, history, clear, 历史保留
set.f.data.chat_retention_days.d: Checked at launch and once a day. Pinned and running chats are kept. Off keeps every chat.
set.f.data.chat_retention_days.syn: retention, chats, cleanup, delete chats older than, 对话保留
set.f.sync.directory.d: It can sit in a cloud drive or a git repository; secrets are not written unless you turn that on below.
set.f.sync.directory.syn: sync, export, directory, 同步文件夹
set.f.sync.include_secrets.d: Writes secrets as plain values. Gateway client tokens and TLS passphrases are never exported.
set.f.sync.auto_export.d: Writes the folder again after each change, in the background. Needs a folder.
set.f.sync.auto_export.syn: auto, export, sync, 自动导出
set.sec.data.storage.d: Everything PingDeck keeps lives in one folder on this computer.
set.sec.data.sync.d: Export writes to this folder and import reads from it: for a second computer or a backup.
set.data.folder.d: Chats, requests, history and keys all live here. Copy the folder only while PingDeck is closed, or use Back up below.
set.data.compact.confirmBody: PingDeck rewrites the database without its {size} of free space. Saving and sending wait until it finishes; on a large database, background writes such as gateway logs may fail while it runs.
set.data.backup.d: Writes a consistent copy of the database, with the secrets file next to it, while PingDeck keeps running. The secrets file is plain text: keep the copy private.
set.data.secrets.d: Stored in a file only you can read (permissions 0600).
set.data.retention.confirmBody.one: {count} chat is older than {days} days and will be deleted at the next launch, then once a day. Pinned chats and chats with a running or waiting run are kept.
set.data.retention.confirmBody.other: {count} chats are older than {days} days and will be deleted at the next launch, then once a day. Pinned chats and chats with a running or waiting run are kept.
set.data.retention.confirmBodyNoCount: Chats older than {days} days will be deleted at the next launch, then once a day. Pinned chats and chats with a running or waiting run are kept.
set.data.history.prune.title: Keep only {keep} entries per source?
set.data.history.prune.body.one: {count} older history entry will be deleted the next time its workspace records a send. This cannot be undone.
set.data.history.prune.body.other: {count} older history entries will be deleted the next time their workspace records a send. This cannot be undone.
set.data.history.prune.bodyNoCount: History entries beyond the newest {keep} of each source in each workspace will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
set.data.attach.confirmOlder.one: This removes {size} of attachments older than {days} days from {count} chat. The chat text stays.
set.data.attach.confirmOlder.other: This removes {size} of attachments older than {days} days from {count} chats. The chat text stays.
set.data.attach.confirmAll.one: This removes {size} of attachments from {count} chat. The chat text stays.
set.data.attach.confirmAll.other: This removes {size} of attachments from {count} chats. The chat text stays.
set.data.output.d: Kept when a tool result is cut, for the agent and “Show full output”: 8 MiB per call, 64 MiB per chat, 2 GiB in all. Known secrets are masked; the files are plain text.
set.data.output.confirmBody: This removes the full output every chat kept. Results in the chats stay as the model saw them.
set.data.bodies.confirmBody: This removes {size} of stored prompts and replies. The request log rows stay.
set.data.bodies.cleared: Removed {size} of captured bodies. Compact the database to shrink the file.
set.data.sync.inspectFailed: Could not check the folder, so secrets stay off: {error}
set.data.sync.remove.d.one: {count} file holds secret values. Removing rewrites it with placeholders.
set.data.sync.remove.d.other: {count} files hold secret values. Removing rewrites them with placeholders.
set.data.sync.remove.confirmBody.one: This rewrites {count} file with placeholders in place of secret values. Other files stay as they are.
set.data.sync.remove.confirmBody.other: This rewrites {count} files with placeholders in place of secret values. Other files stay as they are.
set.data.sync.localOnly: Settings that belong to this computer, such as the proxy, the CA bundle and safety rules, are never imported.
set.data.secrets.title: Written as plain values while this is on:
set.data.gate.title: Turn on secrets for this folder?
set.data.gate.git: {path} is inside a git working tree. Exported keys could be committed and pushed.
set.data.gate.cloud: {path} is inside {name}. Exported keys would be copied to the cloud.
set.data.gate.lists: An export with secrets writes these as plain values:
set.data.gate.never: Gateway client tokens and TLS passphrases are never exported.
set.data.size.attachments.d: Files uploaded in chats. Clearing them keeps the chat text.
set.data.size.bodies.d: Prompts and replies the gateway keeps for its request log.
set.data.secrets.d.windows: Stored in a file only you can read.
set.data.attach.title: Clear attachments
set.data.transfer.d: Import shows a preview first; nothing changes until you press Import.
set.gateway.restart.title: Restart the gateway?
set.gateway.restart.body.one: {count} connection is open and will be dropped.
set.gateway.restart.body.other: {count} connections are open and will be dropped.
set.f.ai.agent.default_target.d: The model a new chat starts with. Last used follows your latest choice.
set.f.ai.agent.fallbacks.d: When the chat's model fails (rate limit, server error, timeout, model gone), the agent tries these in order, at most 5. Applies to whichever model a chat uses.
set.f.ai.agent.fallbacks.syn: fallback, failover, backup model, 备用模型, 故障转移
set.f.ai.agent.default_effort.d: How hard the model reasons by default. Clamped to what the model supports.
set.f.ai.agent.default_workspace.d: File and shell tools work only inside the folder. Without one those tools are off and the chat says “No folder”.
set.f.ai.agent.default_workspace.syn: workspace, directory, folder, 工作目录
set.f.ai.agent.auto_title.d: Gives a new chat a short title after the first answer.
set.f.ai.search.backend.d: Where the web search tool looks. Automatic uses a configured key or address.
set.f.ai.search.backend.syn: web search, tavily, brave, searxng, duckduckgo, 搜索
set.f.ai.search.tavily_key_hint.d: The Tavily API key, kept in secret storage.
set.f.ai.search.tavily_key_hint.syn: api key, tavily, search, 密钥
set.f.ai.search.brave_key_hint.d: The Brave Search API key, kept in secret storage.
set.f.ai.search.brave_key_hint.syn: api key, brave, search, 密钥
set.f.ai.search.searxng_base_url.d: The address of your SearXNG instance.
set.f.ai.search.searxng_base_url.syn: searxng, url, self hosted, 地址
set.f.ai.search.use_duckduckgo: Use DuckDuckGo when no search key is set
set.f.ai.search.use_duckduckgo.d: Sends your search text to DuckDuckGo when no search key or address is set up. Results can be fewer or fail.
set.f.ai.agent.shell_timeout_s.d: How long a command may run by default.
set.f.ai.agent.shell_timeout_s.syn: command, terminal, timeout, 命令超时
set.f.ai.agent.blocked_commands.d: Matching commands are refused in every permission mode. * matches any arguments. This filters command text and can be got around. The sandbox is the boundary.
set.f.ai.agent.blocked_commands.syn: blocked, deny, rm, sudo, 禁止命令
set.f.ai.agent.shell_env_passthrough.d: Commands run in a scrubbed environment without provider keys or gateway tokens. The variable names listed here are passed in.
set.f.ai.agent.shell_env_passthrough.syn: environment, variables, env, 环境变量
set.f.ai.agent.auto_compact.d: Summarises older turns when the context fills up.
set.f.ai.agent.compact_threshold_pct.d: The share of the context window that triggers compaction.
set.f.ai.agent.compact_threshold_pct.syn: context, threshold, percent, 压缩阈值
set.f.ai.agent.keep_recent_turns.d: Turns kept word for word when compacting.
set.f.ai.agent.max_tool_iterations.d: Model calls per run before it pauses and asks to continue.
set.f.ai.agent.max_tool_iterations.syn: steps, iterations, loop, 工具步数
set.f.ai.agent.max_concurrent_runs.d: Runs that work at the same time. Extra runs queue.
set.f.ai.agent.max_subagents.d: Sub-agents one run may have at once. All roles share this count.
set.f.ai.agent.max_image_mb.syn: image, attachment, size, 图片大小
set.f.ai.agent.max_file_mb.syn: file, attachment, size, 文件大小
set.f.ai.agent.image_max_edge_px.d: Larger images are scaled down to this long edge.
set.f.ai.agent.approval_timeout_s.d: Only for runs with no chat window open. A chat you can see never times out.
set.f.ai.agent.approval_timeout_s.syn: approval, timeout, headless, 审批超时
set.f.ai.agent.cost_cap_usd.d: A run whose estimated cost passes this pauses and asks. Off means no limit.
set.f.ai.agent.cost_cap_usd.syn: cost, budget, limit, dollars, 费用上限
set.f.ai.agent.cost_cap_cny.d: A run whose estimated cost passes this pauses and asks. Off means no limit.
set.f.ai.agent.cost_cap_cny.syn: cost, budget, limit, yuan, 费用上限
set.sec.agent.defaults.d: New chats start from here. Each chat can change these on its own.
set.sec.agent.context.d: When a chat fills the model's context, older turns are summarised so the run can continue.
set.agent.roles.nothing: No empty role has a suggestion
set.agent.fb.gateway: Requests from other apps through the gateway: Gateway fallback rules
set.agent.roles.warn.no_price: This model has no price, so the cost limits cannot cover it
set.agent.roles.warn.no_tools: No tool support: the sub-task answers once
set.f.ai.gateway.first_byte_timeout_s.d: How long to wait for a provider to start replying before trying the next key or fallback model.
set.f.ai.gateway.max_retries.d: Each request makes at most N+1 attempts, shared by keys and fallback models.
set.f.ai.gateway.idle_timeout_s.d: How long a stream may stay silent before it is cut. Chat stops at 30 s at most; longer values only apply to the gateway.
set.agent.failover.reset.d: Lets every key and model take requests again at once.
set.agent.failover.resetFailed: Could not reset the circuit state: {reason}
set.agent.failover.restartNote: The gateway still uses the old values until it restarts.
set.agent.failover.restartNext: The gateway uses the new values the next time it starts.
set.agent.folder.pickFailed: Could not open the folder picker: {error}
set.agent.folderMissing: Folder not found. New chats start without a folder.
set.agent.trusted.empty: No folders trusted yet. PingDeck asks the first time a chat uses a folder.
set.agent.sandbox.unavailable: Unavailable here (PingDeck is running inside another sandbox)
set.agent.sandbox.install: On Linux, install bubblewrap (bwrap). Windows has no sandbox in this version.
set.agent.sandbox.asks: Commands ask every time until you choose Run without a sandbox for a chat.
set.agent.sandbox.full: Full access still keeps the sandbox.
set.agent.rules.placeholder: Command pattern, such as git push *
set.agent.limits.calls.one: Up to {count} model call per run
set.agent.limits.calls.other: Up to {count} model calls per run
set.sec.tools.tools.d: These settings apply to every chat; a chat can only make them stricter. Follow mode asks or not according to the chat's permission mode.
set.tools.unreadable: Tool settings could not be read. Reopen this page to try again.
set.tools.group.read_only: Runs without asking by default (in Auto-approve reads)
set.tools.group.changes.noAllow: Tools that run commands or send requests out can't be set to Allow; when you need them, use a remembered rule or Full access.
set.tools.allow.title: Allow {tool} without asking?
set.tools.allow.body: This tool will run without asking in Auto-approve reads mode.
set.f.tools.read_file.d: Read a file inside the chat's folder.
set.f.tools.list_dir.d: List the files and folders in a directory of the folder.
set.f.tools.grep.d: Search file contents in the folder.
set.f.tools.read_skill.d: Open an enabled skill's instructions on demand.
set.f.tools.todo_write.d: Keep the plan shown in the chat.
set.f.tools.web_search.d: Search the web and return titles, links and snippets. A query can carry data out, so it asks by default.
set.f.tools.fetch_url.d: Download one page as text. The URL can carry data out, so it asks by default. Private addresses are refused.
set.f.tools.write_file.d: Create a file or replace one completely.
set.f.tools.edit_file.d: Change part of a file with a patch.
set.f.tools.shell.d: Run a command in the folder, inside the sandbox. Chained commands always ask.
set.f.tools.task.d: Start a sub-agent for a separate job. Its own tool calls follow the rules on this page.
set.f.tools.get_trace.d: Read the timing and headers of a past response.
set.f.tools.list_requests.d: List requests and folders in a collection.
set.f.tools.query_gateway_log.d: Filter the gateway log by status, model, client or time.
set.f.tools.send_request.d: Send a saved or new request and read the response.
set.f.tools.run_probe.d: Probe a model for tools, vision or streaming. Spends tokens.
set.f.tools.create_request.d: Add a request to a collection.
set.tools.mcp.empty.d: Add one, or paste the mcpServers JSON from another app (Claude Desktop, Cursor).
set.tools.mcp.unreadable: MCP servers could not be read. Reopen this page to try again.
set.tools.mcp.reviewFailed: Could not update the server's trust
set.tools.mcp.trust.title: Trust {name}?
set.tools.mcp.trust.body: Its tools then follow your permission rules and its read-only marks count. A tool whose definition changes later asks every time until you review it.
set.tools.mcp.start.title: Start {name}?
set.tools.mcp.start.body: PingDeck runs this command on this computer, outside the sandbox.
set.tools.mcp.addToken: Add a token to list its tools
set.tools.mcp.delete.title: Delete {name}?
set.tools.mcp.delete.body: The server, its stored secrets and its tool settings are removed. Chats that use its tools lose them.
set.tools.mcp.noTools: No tools listed. Refresh tools to read them again.
set.tools.mcp.readOnly: Tools the server marks read-only: {read} of {total}
set.tools.form.name: Name
set.tools.form.name.d: Part of its tool names: 1 to 40 letters, digits, - or _.
set.tools.form.name.taken: A server with this name exists
set.tools.form.env.d: Only these names reach the server. Values are secrets: stored on this computer, never shown again.
set.tools.form.headers.d: Values are secrets: stored on this computer, never shown again.
set.tools.form.trusted.d: May run tools it marks read-only without asking.
set.tools.form.timeout.d: How long one tool call may go without a word from the server; each progress notice restarts the wait. Empty is 120 s, the range 5 to 3,600 s.
set.tools.token.title: Add token for {name}
set.tools.token.d: A static header or bearer token. OAuth sign-in is not available yet.
set.tools.token.hint: Stored on this computer. Never shown again.
set.tools.token.saved: Token saved for {name}. Restart the server to use it.
set.tools.json.title: Edit as JSON
set.tools.json.d: Paste the mcpServers shape of Claude Desktop or Cursor. Imported servers start disabled and not trusted.
set.tools.json.err.entry: {detail} needs a command or a url
set.tools.json.err.name: “{detail}” is not a valid name (1 to 40 letters, digits, - or _)
set.tools.json.err.field: {detail} has a field of the wrong type
set.tools.json.disabled: Imported servers start disabled and not trusted. Turn one on after you checked its command. Values that name a secret of another server are left empty.
set.tools.json.imported.one: {count} server imported, disabled and not trusted
set.tools.json.imported.other: {count} servers imported, disabled and not trusted
set.tools.json.failed: Could not import {name}: {reason}. {count} imported before it.
set.tools.rules.none: No remembered rules. “Always allow” on an approval adds one here.
set.tools.rules.scope.command: Starts with these words, in this folder only
set.tools.rules.scope.argument: Matches this argument, in this folder only
set.f.ai.agent.skill_dirs.d: Folders scanned for skills. ~ means your home folder.
set.f.ai.agent.skill_dirs.syn: skills, folders, directories, 技能目录
set.sec.skills.folders.d: PingDeck reads these folders when this page opens, when a chat starts and when you press Rescan, and never changes the files on disk. Each enabled skill is a /name command in chat; to add a command of your own, write a skill.
set.sec.skills.imported.d: Skills you imported are copied into PingDeck's own folder. Remove deletes the copy only.
set.skills.toggleHint: A disabled skill is hidden from the / list and from the agent.
set.skills.missingDescription: Not usable: SKILL.md is missing a description.
set.skills.empty.title: No skills found in these folders.
set.skills.empty.body: PingDeck looked in {paths}. Put a folder that holds a SKILL.md in one of them, or add another skills folder.
set.skills.importTitle: Choose a folder that holds SKILL.md
set.skills.pickFailed: Could not open the folder picker: {error}
set.skills.removeBody: PingDeck deletes its imported copy. The folder you imported it from is not touched.
When on, PingDeck downloads the catalog from models.dev once it is older than the interval. When off, nothing is downloaded unless you press Sync now.
catalog, models.dev, sync, refresh, update, 模型目录, 同步
set.catalog.err.network: models.dev could not be reached; check the network
set.catalog.err.timeout: models.dev did not answer within 30 seconds
set.catalog.err.tooLarge: the download is larger than 16 MiB, so it was dropped
set.catalog.err.invalid: models.dev did not send a valid model catalog
set.catalog.err.tooFew: the catalog models.dev sent has too few models and looks incomplete, so it was dropped
set.catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID, publisher or distributor
set.catalog.emptyBody: Sync to download the models and prices of models.dev, or add a model of your own.

set.catalog.drawer.addBody: For a model the catalog does not list, such as a relay's own or a local one. Sync never changes it.
set.catalog.drawer.offersBody: What each distributor charges for this model in the models.dev catalog, per 1M tokens. The official offer comes first.

set.catalog.offers.empty: No catalog provider offers this model
set.catalog.field.unit: Prices are per 1M tokens. Input and output are required; leave the others empty for none.
set.catalog.err.clash: The catalog already has this model; use another ID
set.catalog.user.familyHint: Groups the models of one maker, for example openai or custom.
set.catalog.user.name: Name
set.catalog.user.pricesHint: Dynamic pricing reads these prices; leave them empty for no price.
set.catalog.prov.none: None of the providers you configured offers this model yet.
set.catalog.preview.none: No price. Cost shows as unknown.
set.catalog.discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
set.catalog.discard.body: The changes to this model are not saved.
set.catalog.delete.title: Delete {model}?
set.catalog.delete.body: It is removed from the catalog.
set.sec.catalog.providers.d: Make a provider of yours follow one distributor's catalog prices. Precedence: a model's setting for that provider > provider pricing > the model's default price > official price > reference price.
set.catalog.unlisted.d: Models your providers serve that the catalog lacks ({count}).
set.catalog.tip.reference: No official price. The reference price is the median of {count} offers: {family}. Compared: {list}
set.catalog.tip.custom: The price you set for all your providers, instead of the official price
set.catalog.tip.none: The catalog has no price for it; the cost shows as unknown
set.catalog.pp.matched: {matched} of {models} models priced by {family}; the rest use official prices
set.catalog.pp.failed: Could not save the pricing of {provider}: {reason}
set.catalog.drawer.defaultHelp: Used for all your providers unless set otherwise below.
set.catalog.drawer.loadFailed: Could not read the prices of this model: {reason}
set.catalog.drawer.whichBody: This ID is then priced as the model you pick, at {provider} only.
How many days of daily usage totals are kept.
usage, retention, history, 用量保留
set.sec.usage.retention.d: Charts and tables of use are in the Usage module; what each model costs is set in Models and pricing.
set.f.ai.providers.balance_refresh_min.d: Minutes between automatic balance checks for every provider. Off checks when a provider opens and when you press Refresh.
set.usage.retention.title: Lower usage history to {days} days?
set.usage.retention.body: Daily totals older than {days} days are deleted within a minute. This cannot be undone.
set.usage.retention.count.one: {count} daily total older than {days} days is deleted within a minute. This cannot be undone.
set.usage.retention.count.other: {count} daily totals older than {days} days are deleted within a minute. This cannot be undone.
set.usage.openCatalog: Set model prices in Models and pricing
set.f.advanced.script_loop_iteration_lim: Most iterations one script loop may run.
set.f.advanced.script_recursion_limit.d: Deepest nesting of calls in a script.
Most requests one script may send.
script, send, requests, 脚本请求
set.f.advanced.console_max_entries.d: Most console entries one run records. Past it, later output is dropped and the last entry says so.
set.f.advanced.console_max_message_bytes: Longest console message, test name or script error kept. The rest is cut and marked truncated.
console, message, size, 消息大小
set.f.advanced.max_test_results.d: Most pm.test results one run records. Past it, the rest are dropped and one result says so.
set.f.advanced.max_test_results.syn: tests, assertions, results, 测试结果
set.advanced.reset.d: Providers, keys, clients, chats, requests, history and the sync folder are kept.
set.advanced.reset.body: Every setting on every page goes back to its default. You can undo for 8 seconds. Type {word} to confirm.
set.advanced.reset.title: Reset all settings?
set.advanced.reset.kept.retention: Every retention limit and the mock log size
set.advanced.reset.kept.sync: The sync folder and automatic export
set.advanced.reset.kept.data: History, chats, workspaces, providers and keys
set.advanced.reset.kept.records: Permission rules, MCP servers and skills
set.advanced.reset.will.requests: Request defaults, network and mock defaults
set.advanced.reset.will.agent: Agent defaults, personalization and permission mode
set.about.failed: Could not load the app information: {error}
set.about.copy.d: Version, system, sandbox, gateway state and provider count, for reporting a problem. No keys, provider names or hostnames; never sent automatically.
set.sec.personalization.instructions.d: Every new and existing chat carries this text, before the folder's project instructions and the chat's own instructions.
set.f.ai.agent.global_instructions.d: Text every chat carries, such as the language to answer in or how to lay out an answer.
set.f.ai.agent.global_instructions.syn: custom instructions, personalization, system prompt, 我的说明, 个性化, 提示词
set.pz.placeholder: For example: answer in English; give the conclusion first; describe the plan before changing code.
set.pz.over: At most {max} characters; this has {count}. It is not saved.
set.pz.chatNote: A single chat's own instructions are written in the Instructions panel beside the chat; both apply.
set.sec.memory.trusted.d: When a chat uses a folder, PingDeck reads its AGENTS.md (else CLAUDE.md, first 32 KB) and its folder skills, but only if the folder is trusted. If the file changes, the chat asks again.
set.sec.subagents.subagents.d: The main agent can hand a self-contained job to a sub-agent with the task tool. A sub-agent sees only the task, not the chat, and cannot start sub-agents of its own.
set.sec.subagents.roles.d: The model each kind of sub-task runs on. A role without a model is not used; a sub-task then runs on the chat's own model. Under each role you can list the models it switches to, in order, when its model fails.
set.sub.kind.explore.d: Only reads files, searches and lists folders. Runs on the Fast role when it has a model.
set.sub.kind.general.d: Uses the same tools as the main agent, except task.
set.f.ai.agent.role_models.d: The models sub-tasks run on: Fast, Deep thinking and Vision.
set.f.ai.agent.role_models.syn: subagent model, role, fast, deep, vision, 子智能体模型, 角色
set.sec.permissions.sandbox.d: Applies to the shell tool, which runs in the chat's folder.
set.sec.permissions.rules.d: Left by “Always allow” on an approval. A rule matches only the start of a command and is checked again each time; chained commands and high-risk calls ignore it, and Block always wins.
set.f.ai.agent.default_permission_mode.d: Each chat can change it under the message box; Plan is only switched on inside a chat.
set.f.ai.agent.default_permission_mode.s: approval, ask, full access, auto-approve reads, 权限模式, 审批
set.perm.fullRetired: Full access is no longer a default: new chats start in Auto-approve reads. Turn it on inside a chat; it lasts until PingDeck restarts.
set.sec.permissions.order.d: Checked top to bottom; the first layer that decides ends it.
set.perm.order.hard_block.d: Safety rules such as deleting system folders or reading key files; Full access does not pass them
set.perm.order.tool_block.d: Tools set to Block on the Tools page, and stored Block rules
set.perm.order.forced_ask.d: Writes to protected files, untrusted MCP servers, production targets, hosts nobody named
set.perm.order.tool_allow.d: Tools set to Allow on the Tools page
set.perm.trust.d: Which folders a chat may read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and folder skills from is listed under Instructions and trust; revoke a folder's trust there.
set.perm.order.full: Full access lowers none of the first three layers and does not turn off the sandbox.
set.f.ai.agent.sandbox_auto_run.d: Only in Auto-approve reads, and only when all five hold: the sandbox self-test passed, the command gets no network, nothing forces an Ask, its risk is not high, and no Ask or Block rule matches. Off by default.
set.f.ai.agent.sandbox_auto_run.syn: sandbox, auto run, shell, 沙箱, 自动运行
set.f.ai.agent.max_run_tokens.d: Pauses a run, sub-agents included, at this many input and output tokens, as at the cost cap. Empty is Off.
set.f.ai.agent.max_run_tokens.syn: tokens, budget, limit, token 上限, 预算
set.f.ai.agent.wrap_up_last_step.d: The last allowed step calls no tools and asks the model to sum up where it stopped.
set.f.ai.agent.wrap_up_last_step.syn: wrap up, summary, last step, 收尾, 总结
set.f.ai.agent.prompt_cache.d: Auto marks the prompt prefix cacheable on targets whose catalogue entry supports it, Anthropic among them. Off sends no cache hints.
set.f.ai.agent.prompt_cache.syn: cache, prompt cache, 缓存, 提示缓存
set.tools.mcp.log.title: {name} output
set.tools.mcp.log.d: The last 200 lines the server wrote to its error output, and PingDeck's notes such as skipped tools. Secrets are redacted.
set.sec.mcp.mcp.d: External tools over stdio or HTTP. A trusted server may run the tools it marks read-only without asking; its other tools follow their own setting.
set.sec.routing.failover.d: Chat, sub-agents and the gateway all use these. Chat applies a change from its next call; the gateway after a restart.
set.routing.moved: Gateway fallback rules moved to Providers › Gateway › Fallback rules.
